title: Kissed Japanese Rice Bowl
description: A savory yet sweet brunch bowl featuring fragrant basmati rice topped with candied ginger, toasted sesame seeds, and a drizzle of honey-soy sauce.
instructions: Rinse the basmati rice until the water runs clear, then combine it with 2 cups of water in a pot.
Bring the rice to a boil, reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes or until the water is absorbed.
While the rice cooks, whisk together light soy sauce, honey, miso paste, rice vinegar, grated ginger, and sesame oil until the miso is fully dissolved.
When the rice is done, fluff it with a fork and transfer it to a bowl.
Drizzle the honey-soy mixture over the rice and gently stir to combine.
Top the rice with sliced scallions, toasted sesame seeds, chopped candied ginger, and crumbled toasted nori.
Serve warm as a sweet‑savory brunch bowl that satisfies both savory and sweet cravings.
Enjoy immediately or cover and reheat gently before serving.
